definition_quote.value: The practice of optometry is the profession constituting the art and science of visual care and includes any one of the following acts: (a) the optometric examination or optometric diagnosis of all of those physiological or anatomical parts or functions that consummate the process of human vision...
definition_quote.quote: The practice of optometry is the profession constituting the art and science of visual care and includes any one of the following acts

value: employment of drugs topically applied for examination purposes
application or prescription of ophthalmic lenses, contact lenses, prisms, orthoptics, visual training
administration, dispensation, and prescription of oral analgesics
administration, dispensation, and prescription of drugs for ocular treatment
removal of superficial foreign body from the eye or adnexa
methods_authorized.quote: the employment of any optometric means for the purpose of detecting any condition of the process of vision...the application or prescription of ophthalmic lenses, contact lenses, prisms, orthoptics, visual training, and any physical, mechanical, or physiological therapy...the administration, dispensation, and prescription of those drugs approved by the board for use in ocular treatment

drug_authority.value: May administer, dispense, and prescribe topical diagnostic agents (cycloplegics, mydriatics, topical anesthetics, dyes, emergency miotics), oral analgesics (codeine, propoxyphene, hydrocodone, dihydrocodeine alone or in combination with nonscheduled drugs), and board-approved drugs for ocular treatment limited to the anterior segment and adnexa.
drug_authority.quote: the administration, dispensation, and prescription of the oral analgesics codeine, propoxyphene, hydrocodone, and dihydrocodeine, alone or in combination with nonscheduled or nonregulated drugs; and the administration, dispensation, and prescription of those drugs approved by the board for use in ocular treatment limited to the anterior segment of the eye and adnexa.
